title: Your Rook Can Wait
setup: Black's rook has landed on d2, deep in your camp, and its other rook stands on e6 — there is a lot to worry about.
hint: You are being asked to defend. Check first, and see whether the defense ever becomes necessary.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qe8+}} ignores the rook on d2 entirely. {{Rxe8}} is forced, the e-file is handed over, and {{Rxe8#}} arrives. An in-between check costs nothing when the game is over before the threat lands.
